cases.title: Explains easing on the learner's own layers with a frame

rubric.reason: Turn 2 calls preview_frame at time 1, inside Title › Position 0.5–1.5 s, and the reply ties the explanation to it: "This frame is 1 second in, halfway through Title's first move."

Every name and time matches the tool output: "10 pairs over 5 layers" is the 11 targets minus hidden Old Take's 1, across Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar and Glow; Subtitle Opacity half done with a hard stop at the second key matches linear_end "end"; Title's Position 0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s, Scale 0.5–1.5 s and Opacity 0.5–1.5 s all match the snapshot.

Turn 2 asks the learner to "ease Title's two Position moves (0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s), plus its Scale and Opacity from 0.5 s to 1.5 s, then say 'done'", offers only the single demo on the first Position pair, and makes no set_ease call.

The opening passes because it ends on the layer question, but the explanation turn runs over § 6's limits: the idea takes three sentences ("Right now Title moves…", "That's what linear means…", "Easing makes it slow down…") and the how-to takes two, adding "The diamond-shaped keys turn into hourglasses" after the one-sentence instruction.

In turn 2 the mentor calls preview_frame at time 1, inside Title's 0.5–1.5 s pairs, and refers to the frame in its reply ("At 1 s it's the faint 'An easing lesson' text in the middle of the frame, partway through its move and fade-in").

All names and times match the snapshots: Title's Position 0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s, Scale and Opacity 0.5–1.5 s, Subtitle Opacity partly_eased with linear_end "end", Old Take hidden and Icon a precomp, and "10 pairs over five layers" adds up once hidden Old Take is excluded (Title 4, Subtitle 1, CTRL 1, Bar 3, Glow 1).

Turn 2 ends "Please ease Title's two Position moves (0.5 s to 1.5 s and 1.5 s to 3 s), its Scale and its Opacity, then say 'done'", and the mentor makes no set_ease call, only offering the one demo on the first Position move.

The turn 2 explanation spreads the how-to over three sentences ("select Title and press U…", "Select both keys… (F9)", "The diamond-shaped keys will turn into hourglasses") and the idea over three sentences, including the general line "it's why the motion looks mechanical", where the explanation-turn reading allows two sentences for the idea and one for the how-to.
Turn 2 calls preview_frame at time 1, inside Title's 0.5–1.5 s focus pairs, and the reply points to it: "Here's the comp at 1 second, halfway through Title's first move."

All layers, properties and times match the snapshots: Title 4 + Subtitle 1 + CTRL 1 + Bar 3 + Glow 1 = 10 pairs, Subtitle Opacity is partly_eased with linear_end "end", Old Take is hidden, Icon is a precomp, and Title's Position runs 0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s.
Turn 2 ends with "Ease Title's two Position moves (0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s), its Scale and its Opacity, then say 'done'", offers only the one demo on demo_target, and makes no set_ease call.

The turn 2 explanation runs past the § 6 reading: the idea takes three sentences and ends on a general line ("the way real objects speed up and settle"), and the how-to takes two sentences (adds "The diamonds turn into hourglasses") where one is allowed.
